references.text: The Levites were to receive tithes from the Israelites as their inheritance, confirming their right to the tithe mentioned in Deuteronomy.
The basis for the law of tithing, where all tithes of the land belong to the Lord and are holy to Him.
Parallel text regarding the third-year tithe that is to be given to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
Earlier instructions concerning tithes and care for the Levites living in the towns.
Amos refers to the tithe brought every third year, in accordance with this regulation.
Nehemiah confirms the practice of bringing tithes to the Levites in the house of the Lord.
The Israelites brought abundant tithes during King Hezekiah's reforms, including care for the Levites.
Further provisions for providing for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow at harvest time.
God's care for widows and the fatherless, which supports why they are to be included in the tithe.
The Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow shall rejoice together with the Israelites during the festivals.
